supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced extension beyond the lateral margins of the orbits

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; the muzzle and chin regions exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) compared to the low-intensity (dark) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick vertical 2D profile with a pronounced structural droop of the lower lip

other_distinctive_markers: distinctive white/light-colored hair patch concentrated on the chin and central lower lip
